title: Propheta's letters to Jim Garrison in the Garrison files
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Propheta's letters to Jim Garrison in the Garrison files, about 1960s at New Orleans, Louisiana; the Bronx, New York, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.
place_text: New Orleans, Louisiana; the Bronx, New York

tellings.quote: where the leader of the church, guy called Propheta, was writing letters to Jim Garrison saying, "When you're finished with Jack Martin, can you send him back to us?" Right.

plain: Peter Levenda, an author who writes about secret history, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about the 1960s files of Jim Garrison, a New Orleans district attorney who looked into the Kennedy assassination. Levenda says the files hold letters from the leader of a small church based in the Bronx, a man called Propheta, asking Garrison to send a man named Jack Martin back to them once he was finished with him. If true, it would link an obscure church to people caught up in the Kennedy case.
